comparison.objective: Press a sprung door shut and throw its deadbolt into the strike.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain door-closing force with one arm while rotating a thumb-turn with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt extended at least 23 mm with the door gap at most 3 mm and stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Coupled holding and rotary locking are unrelated to selective passage of media through a physical screen.
